svg.title: A render cycle: an event calls setState, React schedules a re-render, calls the component again with the new state snapshot, compares the new JSX with the old, and updates only the changed parts of the DOM

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Each render sees a snapshot; the DOM changes only where the output changed.
